name: Z.ai free Flash models
amount: GLM-4.7-Flash, GLM-4.5-Flash and GLM-4.6V-Flash priced free; one request at a time
summary: Z.ai prices its three Flash models at $0 on its international API. GLM-4.5-Flash has an announced retirement. An account and API key are needed; overseas phone numbers are reported to work, and the chat API doesn't require real-name verification. Z.ai's privacy policy says it uses data to improve its services, including training its models. The models themselves are tracked in the directory once our key is set up.
source_note: Z.ai pricing page and privacy policy, checked 2026-09-28. The weekly page check flags changes to the free list.
